title: rustra.json
description: Configuration for the rustra CLI (@rustra/cli). Editor validation and completion via the $schema keyword.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor validation. rustra init inserts ./node_modules/@rustra/cli/rustra.schema.json; keep it pointing at the schema shipped with @rustra/cli.

schema.description: Path to the schema JSON produced by the Rust generate step.

output.description: Directory the TypeScript sources are generated into.

cppOutput.description: Directory the C++ sources are generated into (enables the C++ surface).

positional.description: Emit the positional facade alongside the byId API.

rustManifest.description: Path to the Cargo.toml the generate binary lives in.

rustPackage.description: Cargo package name that owns the generate binary.

rustBinary.description: Cargo binary invoked for codegen (defaults to the generate-style binary).

moduleDir.description: Directory the generated React Native module is written to.

rustManifest.description: Path to the Cargo.toml hosting the staticlib target.

rustPackage.description: Cargo package name that owns the staticlib.

rustLibrary.description: Static-library identifier (crate name of the .a/.lib artifact).

legacyBenchmarks.description: Keep generating the legacy benchmark harness.

rustManifest.description: Path to the Cargo.toml hosting the codegen binary.

rustPackage.description: Cargo package name that owns the binary.

args.description: Extra arguments passed to the codegen binary.

rustManifest.description: Path to the Cargo.toml hosting the cdylib.

rustPackage.description: Cargo package name that owns the cdylib.

rustLibrary.description: Cdylib identifier loaded by the Bun FFI runtime.

tauri.description: Reserved for Tauri-specific options; currently only an empty object is accepted.

target.description: Backend the dev loop rebuilds. wasm requires a reactNative section and is dev-only.

engine.description: wasm interpreter used on device. Only wasm3 is supported.

parityGate.description: Compare native and wasm32 responses byte-for-byte on every reload (default true).

inspector.description: Inspector settings (devtools-side; tooling availability is reported by rustra doctor).

onMismatch.description: Reaction when the runtime contract mismatches: diagnose (default) or ignore.
